Explore our wide range of benchtop surface solutions, featuring options across an expansive collection of High Pressure Laminate that emulates the look and feel of marble, stone and natural timber.

Our Formica range of HPL allows you to create beautiful laminate benchtops, no matter your budget, while our silica free HIMACS® range provides a durable, smooth, non-porous and visually seamless surface solution, which meets the highest standards for quality, aesthetics, fabrication, functionality and hygiene.
